glossary.ſanspeine: sans peine — without difficulty, easily (adverbial phrase; printed as one word, printed with the long s)
glossary.ſe: se — himself, herself, itself, themselves (reflexive pronoun, 3rd person; printed with the long s)
glossary.ſecondes: second — second (adj. f. pl.); en ſecondes [noces], in a second marriage (printed with the long s)
glossary.ſemblables: semblable — like, similar (adj. pl.); de ſemblables, others like them (printed with the long s)
glossary.ſens: sens — sense (m.); bon ſens, good sense (printed with the long s)

glossary.ſerais: estre (être) — to be (conditional, 2nd sg.; printed with the long s)
glossary.ſerait: estre (être) — to be (conditional, 3rd sg.; printed with the long s)

glossary.ſeroit: estre (être) — to be (conditional, 3rd sg.; 1697 spelling of serait, printed with the long s)
glossary.ſeront: estre (être) — to be (future, 3rd pl.; printed with the long s)
glossary.ſerrer: serrer — to tighten, lace tight (infinitive; printed with the long s)
glossary.ſes: ses — his, her, its (possessive adj. pl.; printed with the long s)
glossary.ſexe: sexe — sex; le ſexe, the fair sex, women (m.; printed with the long s)
glossary.ſeïeroient: seoir — to suit, become (conditional, 3rd pl.; 1697 form of siéraient, printed with the long s)
glossary.ſi: si — so (adverb); if (conjunction) (printed with the long s)
glossary.ſilence: silence — silence (m.; printed with the long s)
glossary.ſix: six — six (printed with the long s)
glossary.ſon: son — his, her, its (possessive adj. m. sg.); also son, sound (m.) (printed with the long s)

glossary.ſonné: sonner — to strike (of a clock) (past participle; printed with the long s)
glossary.ſorte: sorte — sort, kind (f.); de ſorte que, so that (printed with the long s)

glossary.ſortoit: sortir — to come out (imperfect, 3rd sg.; 1697 spelling of sortait, printed with the long s)
glossary.ſouffrir: souffrir — to bear, tolerate; to suffer (infinitive; faire ſouffrir, to inflict; printed with the long s)
glossary.ſouffroit: souffrir — to bear, endure (imperfect, 3rd sg.; 1697 spelling of souffrait, printed with the long s)
glossary.ſouhaiteroit: souhaiter — to wish (conditional, 3rd sg.; 1697 spelling of souhaiterait, printed with the long s)

glossary.ſur: sur — on, upon (preposition; ſur toutes choſes, above all; printed with the long s)
glossary.ſçavoir: sçavoir (savoir) — to know, find out (infinitive; 1697 spelling of savoir, printed with the long s)

glossary.ſœurs: sœur — sister (f. pl.; printed with the long s)
